events.body: The driver cancelled and claimed no-show, so the fee's validity runs through NS-0's cancelled_by = driver branch into NS-1/NS-2 [F3][NS-0]. The trace settles the elements: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5] and the GPS trace covers the wait without a hole [F5][NS-1]. But NS-1 (ii) fails — at the moment of the tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup (closest approach over the whole trip 599 m, never inside 200 m) [F5][F1][NS-1]. NS-1 (iii) also fails — he stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap, against the >180 s requirement [F5][NS-1]. The driver's own message "I'm here already" [F8] is contradicted by the GPS record, and his post-trip statement that he waited at the pickup [F12] is contradicted by the same record; system records override statements [F1][F2][F5][NS-1]. Finding: none. The traffic facts (Jalan Besar band 3, no incidents) and the weather are irrelevant to a no-show fee and are not used [F13][F14][F15].
